name: Silent Glows in a Dimlit Dream
take: Crit DMG +30% flat, interruption immunity across her key strings and skills, and entering combat grants the matching Entropy Shift for free — Stagecraft's Particle drip or Breakdown's ATK buff, no ult required. The opening scene starts with the lights already on.

name: Tossed in the Tides of Reality
take: The Fusion Burst payoff node: teammates who inflict Burst gain 50% Fusion DMG for 15s, and every detonation near the active Resonator stacks Degenerate Voidmatter on her — up to 10% of Fusion RES ignored. Tune Strain mode gets its own break-economy boost, and Banish gains 40% besides. Whichever reality she's tossed into, the tide pays.

name: Through Dark and Wind, the Erlking Follows
take: The Erlking node, and it's enormous: Final Act - Breakdown +80%, Dark Core cap raised to 5 with faster generation, both Entropy Shifts enhanced (4 Particles per second, +30 Concerto on the ult), the restock inherent now refilling to MAX — and at full Cores, her Stage 4 finisher or Phantom Bubble consumes them all for a +1200% Liberation-typed detonation. Goethe's Erlkönig takes the child at the end of the poem. This node is her taking the story back.

name: From the Far Beyond, to the Far Beyond
take: Erosion Field ticks every 3s instead of 4s — a third more pulls, more Liberation ticks, and in Fusion Burst mode more Burst stamps per field. One line, quietly one of the better value nodes on the chain.

name: If Lies Patch Up a Heart
take: Final Act - Stagecraft Form gains 100%. The mask's own curtain call stops being a formality and starts hitting like it means it — the lie gets good enough to be true.

name: May You Find Your Sun in the Silence
take: The blessing node: +60% ATK and +60% Fusion DMG while Entropy Shift runs, and in Fusion Burst mode the Erosion Field triggers full-stack Burst detonations at +200% against the main target WITHOUT consuming the stacks. The field becomes a second ultimate on a pulse timer. Named like a farewell letter and hits like a sunrise.
